headline: Apartment Interior within Poznań's Łazarz District / LBWA
context: Designed by the LBWA studio, the apartment, located in a historic tenement building in the Łazarz district of Poznań , not only reflects the character of the historic structure but also introduces fresh, contemporary elements that give it a unique and functional character.
